data.exact_reserve_text: Partially offsetting the favourable premium variance in the period was an increase in incurred claims particularly on the 2015 year of account, primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount. The combined ratio is marginally favourable to 2016 at 98.3% being the combination of favourable acquisition and expense ratios and unfavourable movements in the claims ratio. The result at 36 months follows the increase in incurred claims primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount.

prior_year_events.impact_description: increase in incurred claims primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount for the 2015 year of account

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening in prior year reserves, primarily driven by an increase in incurred claims for the 2015 year of account due to an increase in the average claim amount. This contributed to an unfavourable movement in the overall claims ratio, despite favourable acquisition and expense ratios.
raw_causal_phrases: increase in incurred claims particularly on the 2015 year of account
increase in the average claim amount
unfavourable movements in the claims ratio
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 14 indicates a gross release of GBP 0.321m for prior years (2011-2015). However, the narrative on page 1 explicitly states 'increase in incurred claims particularly on the 2015 year of account' and 'unfavourable movements in the claims ratio', and that the 2015 year of account closed at a net loss of GBP 64k. Prioritizing the narrative as per instructions, the direction is inferred as strengthening, but no gross amount for this strengthening is quantified in the narrative. The triangle data is included in the _claims_triangle field for reference.
